==Walkthrough==
{{Checklist|*Talk to the [[Squire]] in the [[White Knights' Castle]]. {{Chat option|1And how is life as a squire?|2I can make a new sword if you like...|1So would these dwarves make another one?|1Ok, I'll give it a go.}}
*Talk to [[Reldo]] in the library of [[Varrock Palace]]. {{Chat option|2. What do you know about the Imcando dwarfs?}} ({{Chat option|4. What do you know about the Imcando dwarfs?}} if [[Shield of Arrav]] not started.) Skip this step if you already met Thurgo during [[The Giant Dwarf]].
*Talk to [[Thurgo]] south of [[Port Sarim]] (by the anvil, north of the [[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|AIQ}}) and give him a [[redberry pie]]. {{Chat option|2Would you like a redberry pie?}} ({{Chat option|3Would you like a redberry pie?}} if [[The Giant Dwarf]] quest is in progress.)
*Talk to him again. {{Chat option|1Something else.}}
*Go back and talk to the Squire.
*Climb-up the ladder on the eastern side of the castle to the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}. Go west and climb-up the eastern staircase. Search the [[cupboard (The Knight's Sword)|cupboard]] in [[Sir Vyvin]]'s bedroom for a [[portrait]]. '''He must not be looking at you.'''
*Proceed back to [[Thurgo]] and give him the [[portrait]]. {{Chat option|1About that sword...}} Bring iron bars with you.
*Go to the [[Asgarnian Ice Dungeon]] using the trapdoor to the east of [[Thurgo]].
*Once inside, follow the path west, north, and then east. Keep along the southern wall in the icy area and mine a [[blurite ore]]. Mine another if planning on doing the [[Falador Diary|Falador Easy Diary]].
*Talk to Thurgo with your [[iron bar]]s and [[blurite ore]]. {{Chat option|1Can you make that replacement sword now?}}
*Bring the sword to the Squire.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
